label: organizations confirmed breached by name
detail: Still no organization confirmed breached by name, even after the KEV listing (ZDNet Korea, Oct 27; BleepingComputer, Oct 27). Wiz (Oct 27) has seen no end-to-end success in its own telemetry; the only confirmed compromises remain Karimi's honeypots. A SOCRadar report on a Japanese real-estate extortion operator found PHP2Shell tooling on the operator's server but 'no link between PHP2Shell and these intrusions'.

label: exploit attempts on TU Delft's sensors alone (Cloudflare: millions)
detail: Exploitation requests against TU Delft's honeypots and telescope, Oct 21 08:37 UTC to Oct 26 21:39 UTC, from 626 IPs in 71 countries; 171 IPs sent code or a dropper. Their sensors only; furthest step attempted, not success. Cloudflare's 'millions' (by Oct 22) still stands.
source_label: TU Delft dashboard, updated Oct 26 21:39 UTC

label: UK government digital services confirmed unavailable
detail: Plus four partially unavailable, mostly precautionary. The NCSC has issued about 50,000 warnings.

label: PHP services Censys counts on affected versions
detail: PHP services still running an affected version, per Censys as cited by The Hacker News on Oct 27 (down from 41M+ on Oct 22 by Censys's earlier count; the two counts may not be like-for-like).

label: drop in vulnerable exposed machines in Wiz's data
detail: Drop in the daily count of vulnerable internet-exposed machines in Wiz's data since disclosure (window 'the past few days'); under 53% of initially affected organizations remain vulnerable a week on. Wiz's customer data only.

label: on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list (2 of 3 flaws)
detail: CISA added CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to the KEV catalog on Oct 26 (version 2026.10.26, released 22:24 UTC); federal civilian agencies must act by Oct 29; forensic triage required; ransomware use 'Unknown'. CVE-2026-115560 not listed. CISA has named no victim and described no attack. No emergency directive found.
source_label: CISA KEV catalog, version 2026.10.26, opened Oct 27

label: sites and services paused in Japan over the flaws
detail: Sites and services suspended in Japan over the flaws (cumulative); about 40% had no confirmed restart as of Oct 26. Counted by Assured from company social-media posts; precautionary outages, no unauthorized access reported.
